name: Talking to a grumpy Boop still gets a face
case: The person pokes Boop until it's grumpy, then a few seconds later says sorry and that it's doing great. Boop is still grumpy, but it answers the kind words with a face, never none: a proud, happy or excited one.
why: PERSONALITY: talked to, Boop always answers with a face, never none, proud at kind words, whatever its mood (BEHAVIORS.md §3.3). A grumpy mood from pokes mustn't make it ignore you
